items.description: The Maharashtra Charity Commissioner has approved the Tata Social Welfare Trust's proposal to invest an amount of Rs 150 crore. items.author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
items.description: Current housing data shows a significant price gap between newly built homes and existing properties. Builders are implementing price cuts and incentives to attract buyers amid weaker demand. A median family finds new homes slightly more affordable than existing ones, despite high mortgage rates. Certain markets still experience severe housing cost burdens, requiring a significant portion of income for mortgage payments.

items.title: Retail investors turn net sellers in November as FIIs pile into Indian stocks
items.description: In November, retail investors, mutual funds, and insurance companies sold significant amounts of Indian growth assets. Retail investors experienced their largest selling in history, totaling around ₹24,953 crore. This marks the second consecutive month of outflows from retail investors. Additionally, mutual funds reported their first monthly net selling since August 2022, amounting to ₹34,929 crore. Despite the selling trend, retail investors have maintained a net buying position in 2026.

items.title: Rupee hits 8-month high, wipes out this year’s losses
items.author: TNN
items.description: The Indian rupee gained 72 paise to close at 92.23 against the US dollar on Wednesday. This appreciation was driven by strong foreign portfolio inflows and lower crude oil prices supporting the currency. Foreign investments in Indian equities reached a record $14.3 billion this month, contributing to the rupee's growth. The Reserve Bank of India sold a net $6.9 billion in September, contrasting with previous months.

items.description: Justice M S Ramachandra Rao has been recommended for the position of Chief Justice of the Karnataka high court. This potential appointment would mark his seventh high court assignment since 2012 when he became a judge. He has previously served as Chief Justice in four high courts over a short period. Justice Rao has experienced multiple transfers throughout his judicial career due to various circumstances.

items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: A Minnesota couple sued their neighbour after he put up a sign claiming they had no harbour access and parked his boat along their waterfront, disrupting their attempts to sell two properties. An appeals court ruled that their property titles expressly granted water access, upheld findings of slander of title and nuisance, and confirmed a $64,061 attorney-fee award.

items.author: PERVEZ IQBAL SIDDIQUI, SHAILVEE SHARDA, SANDEEP RAI
items.description: Congress MP Imran Masood expressed doubts about the intentions of Samajwadi Party during ongoing seat-sharing negotiations. The discussions, which lasted 3.5 hours, were complicated by SP's announcement of five candidates, causing tension. Masood emphasized that Congress seeks a significant number of seats for the 2027 elections while supporting Akhilesh Yadav for CM. SP leaders dismissed Masood's concerns as personal and affirmed no formal objections were raised.

items.title: Lamp not lit atop deepathoon, Supreme Court to hear contempt case
items.author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
items.description: The Tamil Nadu government has not complied with the Supreme Court's order regarding the Karthigai Deepam lamp lighting. Various political parties and the Madurai district administration oppose the lighting of the lamp atop the deepathoon. The Collector reported efforts to follow the Supreme Court's directive, which were ultimately unsuccessful.

items.title: India tops in videos removed from YouTube
items.author: TNN
items.description: YouTube took down approximately 34.4 lakh videos from India in the second quarter of 2026. This number represented a 28% increase from the previous quarter's removals. Globally, child safety issues were responsible for the majority of video removals. Additionally, Indian courts and government agencies sent numerous removal requests to Google. Police primarily initiated these requests, reflecting a growing trend in content regulation.

items.title: Delhi high court to hear today Saurav Das’s plea seeking travel nod to UK
items.author: TNN
items.description: Saurav Das, co-convener of CJP, has taken his case to the Delhi High Court after being barred from traveling to the UK. He reported being halted at immigration without any visible orders, claiming the travel ban relates to his scheduled discussions at UK institutions.

items.title: Government rejects structural excess capacity charge
items.author: TNN
items.description: Rejecting claims of surplus capacity in any sector, the Indian government emphasises its commitment to forging a strong bilateral trade agreement with the US. Recent tariff negotiations hit a snag following a US Supreme Court ruling, temporarily halting progress. However, prior to this, an accord on extra tariffs was already negotiated. Optimism remains high among Indian officials that the deal can be finalised, contingent on the US's tariff policy developments.

items.description: The India Pavilion received the Visitors’ Lion Award for Best National Participation at the Venice Art Biennale. items.title: Missing businessman's non-bailable warrant cancelled in AJL case, ED to move HC
items.author: PRADEEP THAKUR
items.description: A special MP/MLA court in Rouse Avenue cancelled a non-bailable warrant against businessman Dinesh Pandey. The Enforcement Directorate is surprised and plans to appeal this decision in the Delhi high court. Pandey is reportedly involved in transferring Rs 10.4 crore through a shell company to Associated Journals Ltd. The court criticized the investigating officer for using a sealed cover, which is typically standard practice.

items.title: Psychology says reading comments before a video can shape your expectations
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Many individuals read comments before diving into videos, using them as a barometer for potential enjoyment. Studies show that the tone of these comments, whether uplifting or critical, significantly shapes the audience's emotional engagement, especially with content geared towards sensitive themes. This trend underscores the subjective journey of online media consumption and the varying perceptions each viewer brings to the table.

items.title: Allahabad high court to hear Rahul Gandhi’s plea against PIL, says Supreme Court
items.author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
items.description: Supreme Court has quashed an order from the Allahabad high court to investigate Rahul Gandhi's assets. The high court did not consider Gandhi's response before issuing the order, which raised procedural concerns. Senior advocate Kapil Sibal criticized the order, claiming it permitted a witch-hunt without examining the petitioner's standing. The court will allow Gandhi to present his arguments regarding the petition's validity and the petitioner's status.
